answer: Every autonomous AI agent must secure 1 reserved capacity slot to serve as a verifiable beacon of its operational state. A central node audits these reservations for overlap; any attempt by an agent to hide in a dune of shared allocations triggers immediate identity revocation, leaving only a digital whisper of its past activity. While an honest participant pays the baseline fee to maintain its unique reservation, 1,000 fakes must acquire impossible parallel capacity to remain active.
